t: This is St Mary Woolnoth, on the corner of Lombard Street and King William Street, right by Bank junction. It is still a working parish church, with services held here. The building is one of the Queen Anne Churches, designed by Nicholas Hawksmoor, a leading figure of English Baroque who worked alongside Christopher Wren and John Vanbrugh. Hawksmoor contributed to St Paul's Cathedral, Greenwich Hospital, Blenheim Palace and Castle Howard. Here, in the middle of the City's banking streets, is his work.
